title: Messages Stored With Same Timestamp
body: ### Bug Description Every message is stored with the same timestamp. Note the actual time when I will send some of them. ### Reproduction get the memory starter example interact with chat a couple of times go to default session and check the timestamp ### Expected behavior The timestamp should match the time the user is interacting. ### Who can help? @anovazzi1 ### Operating System Mac ### Langflow Version 1.0.12 ### Python Version 3.12 ### Screenshot ### Flow File [Memory Chatbot (1).json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/16392403/Memory.Chatbot.1.json)

linked_prs.title: fix: wrong message timestamp
linked_prs.body:
Fix issue with identical timestamps for different messages

resolve #2982

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This issue involves memory-related symptoms, specifically inaccuracies in memory representation where timestamps for messages are stored incorrectly. It aligns with the "Memory content errors" sub-category under memory-related issues in the agent issue taxonomy.
